children: Motilal Oswal's research report on Dr Reddys Laboratories

DRRD delivered in-line revenue in 2QFY27, whereas EBITDA/PAT came in 30% ahead of our estimate, adjusting for the one-time income. The beat was largely driven by increased sales of limited competition products like g- Bosutinib in North America (NA) and superior execution in the domestic formulation (DF) segment. 2QFY27 was the first quarter of improved quarterly sales in NA (USD264m) after six quarters.

We reduce our earnings estimates by 3%/2% for FY27/FY28, factoring in formulary addition-led gestation period for abatacept sales and moderate demand for PSAI segment products. We value DRRD at 20x 12-month forward earnings to arrive at a TP of INR1,180.
